name: Timesheet Approval
description:
'The "Timesheet Approval" app streamlines the process of timesheet submission, approval, rejection, and reporting, making it easier for employees and managers to manage time entries efficiently.' 

        'Key Features:'
        '1) Timesheet Submission Workflow:'
        '   - Employees submit timesheets that move from draft to approval or rejection.'
        '2) Manager Approvals and Rejections:'
        '   - Managers can approve or reject timesheets with reasons for rejections provided.'
        '3) Bulk Approval and Rejection:'
        '   - Approve or reject multiple timesheets simultaneously, improving productivity.'
        '4) Revert to Draft:'
        '   - Admins can revert approved or rejected timesheets to the draft state if necessary.'
        '5) Customizable Timesheet Analysis Reports:'
        '   - Generate detailed reports filtered by date, project, task, employee, and status.'
        '6) Exportable Excel Reports:'
        '   - Export timesheet analysis for in-depth data review in Excel format.'
        '7) Easy Navigation and Approvals:'
        '   - Approve or reject timesheets directly from the tree view for faster processing.'

        'Workflow Highlights:'
        '   - Submission: Employees submit timesheets for approval.'
        '   - Approval/Rejection: Managers review and take action with detailed reasons.'
        '   - Reporting: Create customized reports for timesheet analysis.'
        '   - Bulk Operations: Speed up processing with bulk approvals and rejections.'

        'This app ensures accuracy, efficiency, and flexibility in managing employee timesheets within Odoo workflows.'
